product.title: Moab Rivertrippers ~Rafting Castle Valley/Fisher Towers Half-Day

description.text: Raft the iconic Colorado River through Castle Valley, also known as the Fisher Towers section just outside Moab. This is the stretch every Moab rafting trip is built around, even if you see it called by different names. No matter the name, you are on the same legendary section of the Colorado River.Splash, laugh, and cool off as you move through a mix of calm sections and fun rapids. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
